hands_on_tech.overview: Production-grade career development, job search engineering, application packaging, and interview readiness toolchain for modern professionals entering tech, creative, and business domains in 2026/2027. Anchored in primary recruitment platforms—LinkedIn & LinkedIn Jobs, Naukri, Indeed, National Career Service (NCS), and direct enterprise career portals (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever). Application document engineering is mastered across Google Docs and Microsoft Word with strict single-column ATS parsing compliance. Pipeline management, company targeting, and follow-up CRM are centralized in LinkedIn Job Tracker and Google Sheets. Supervised generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) accelerate market intelligence, skills-gap analysis, bullet-point impact phrasing (Google X-Y-Z formula), and mock interview simulations. Practical proof of work is published across role-specific portfolio hubs: Behance (Design), Figma (UI/UX), GitHub (Web/Python), live web deployments, commercial showreels (Video/Motion), growth audits (Digital Marketing), and workflow blueprints (AI Automation). Interview execution is trained through virtual video environments (Google Meet, Zoom) and asynchronous video presentations (Loom). The entire toolstack is governed by a strict zero-paid-subscription policy, candidate privacy safeguards, ethical job-search protocols, and institutional simulation fallbacks.

software_licensing_and_zero_cost_policy.student_zero_cost_commitment: The entire curriculum is engineered around 100% accessible zero-cost tools and free tiers. LinkedIn and Naukri candidate profiles operate on free standard tiers. Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) is utilized via free personal Google accounts. Microsoft Word is accessible via free online web apps or standard educational licenses. Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) operate strictly within accessible free web tiers. Digital portfolio platforms (GitHub, Behance, Figma free starter) require zero paid hosting. Loom provides a free tier (up to 25 videos of 5 minutes each), fully sufficient for all assessed project walkthroughs and video screening exercises. Zero mandatory paid subscriptions or third-party purchases are required.
software_licensing_and_zero_cost_policy.hardware_and_workstation_baseline: Standard consumer workstation or laptop running 64-bit Windows 10/11, macOS 12+, or modern Linux. Minimum hardware baseline: dual-core modern processor, 8 GB RAM, functional webcam, clear microphone, and reliable broadband internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload for HD video interviews and screen sharing).
software_licensing_and_zero_cost_policy.no_paid_subscription_mandate: Students are strictly instructed NOT to purchase LinkedIn Premium, Jobscan paid scanning credits, Naukri FastForward paid boosts, or paid AI subscriptions (e.g., ChatGPT Plus). The curriculum evaluates candidate competency, positioning, empirical proof of work, and interview performance rather than paid platform boosts.
software_licensing_and_zero_cost_policy.responsible_ai_usage_and_candidate_priva: Generative AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) are utilized strictly as supervised analytical and drafting coaches for job description decomposition, skills-gap mapping, resume impact refinement, and mock question generation. AI must NEVER invent unearned credentials, degrees, job titles, previous employer names, project outcomes, or technical skills. Students are strictly prohibited from uploading confidential employer data, non-disclosure agreement (NDA) protected intellectual property, or unredacted personal identification to public AI contexts.
software_licensing_and_zero_cost_policy.simulation_fallback_for_ineligible_learn: For learners facing platform verification delays, geographical limitations, or age eligibility constraints, Nova Skills provides pre-approved offline simulation packs, mock employer job feeds, and structured submission rubrics. 100% of course competencies, portfolio deliverables, and placement readiness credentials can be achieved through simulated classroom environments without active external job board profiles.

platform_governance_and_compliance_polic.anti_spam_and_recruiter_etiquette: Nova Skills strictly enforces professional recruitment etiquette. Students are prohibited from automated mass connection spamming, generic copypasta cold messaging, scraping recruiter contact lists, or badgering hiring managers. All outreach must be personalized, value-driven, and respectful of professional boundaries.
platform_governance_and_compliance_polic.academic_integrity_and_zero_cheating: Strict prohibition against using AI covertly during live employer take-home tests, timed coding rounds, or video interviews where external AI assistance is disallowed. Zero tolerance for submitting borrowed, shared, or uncredited portfolio work or having third-party proxies complete screening tests.
platform_governance_and_compliance_polic.truth_in_hiring_pledge: 100% factual accuracy is required across all resumes, LinkedIn profiles, and job applications. Misrepresenting academic projects as commercial client contracts without disclosure, inflating past compensation, or fabricating employment dates is grounds for immediate academic disciplinary action.

faq.question: Who can enroll in this program?
faq.answer: This course is open to fresh graduates, final-year college students, learners completing technical training, entry-level job seekers, and career switchers who possess foundational technical skills in their chosen discipline.

faq.question: Is this course suitable for freshers with no prior work experience?
faq.answer: Yes, absolutely. The curriculum is specifically engineered to help fresh graduates build credibility through verifiable project case studies, academic proof of work, ATS resumes, and professional LinkedIn branding.

faq.question: Are technical skills required before enrolling?
faq.answer: Yes. This program focuses on employment readiness, portfolio engineering, and recruitment performance. You must possess foundational technical skills in your discipline (design, development, video, marketing, or automation) or be concurrently enrolled in technical training.

faq.question: Is concurrent technical training permitted while taking this course?
faq.answer: Yes. Many students enroll concurrently in a Nova Skills technical course or external degree program. Projects developed during concurrent technical training can be adapted into the portfolio case studies and technical assessment requirements.

faq.question: What are the 3-month and 120-hour time commitments?
faq.answer: The program runs for 3 months (12 weeks) and comprises exactly 120 guided instructional hours. This follows an engineered weekly rhythm of 10 hours: 3h conceptual lecture, 3h hands-on studio, 2h role assessment, and 2h mentoring/mock interview lab.

faq.question: Are role-specific job assessments included?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 09 is dedicated to industry-specific hiring assessments. Students complete a realistic 48-hour employer-grade take-home challenge tailored specifically to their chosen specialization track.

faq.question: Which career specializations are supported?
faq.answer: We support 8 career specialization tracks: (1) Graphic & Brand Design, (2) UI/UX & Product Design, (3) Video Editing & Motion Graphics, (4) Generative AI Video, (5) Digital Marketing & Growth, (6) Frontend & Web Development, (7) Python & Backend Development, and (8) AI Automation.

faq.question: Do learners complete every technical track?
faq.answer: No. Each learner selects exactly ONE primary career specialization track for assessment. Optional adjacent-role exercises may be explored for personal learning, but graduation requires mastering your primary discipline without expanding course hours.

faq.question: What is an ATS-compatible resume?
faq.answer: An ATS (Applicant Tracking System) compatible resume uses clean, single-column formatting, standard section headers, readable fonts, and zero complex tables or graphics that cause database parsing errors. It emphasizes quantified Google X-Y-Z achievement bullets.

faq.question: Are LinkedIn and Naukri covered in the curriculum?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 04 focuses extensively on LinkedIn profile optimization and recruiter search visibility. Module 06 covers Naukri, Indeed India, National Career Service (NCS), and corporate enterprise portals.

faq.question: Is AI job-search assistance taught?
faq.answer: Yes. We teach students how to use AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude) responsibly for resume bullet refinement, mock interview simulations, company research, and speech pacing audits, while upholding strict factual integrity.

faq.question: Will students build professional portfolios?
faq.answer: Yes. Students build role-specific digital portfolios hosted on industry-standard platforms (GitHub for developers, Behance/Figma for designers, Vimeo/Drive for video editors, Notion/Web for marketers and automation specialists).

faq.question: How many project case studies are required?
faq.answer: Graduation requires two in-depth commercial-grade case studies documented using the Problem-Action-Result (PAR) methodology with verifiable proof of contribution and asynchronous video walkthroughs.

faq.question: Are live job applications compulsory to complete the course?
faq.answer: No. Submitting live job applications to external companies is not compulsory. Students can complete all application assignments using approved, faculty-reviewed realistic corporate simulations if they are not yet ready to apply publicly.

faq.question: Are mock interviews included?
faq.answer: Yes. Students participate in two evaluated behavioral mock interviews (using the STAR methodology), aptitude screening simulations, and an advanced technical panel defense interview before faculty assessors.

faq.question: Is aptitude training included in the curriculum?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 08 covers corporate screening fundamentals: quantitative problem-solving, logical deduction, reading comprehension, timed test-taking strategies, and asynchronous video screening (HireVue format).

faq.question: Are technical interviews practiced?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 10 is dedicated to technical cross-examination, portfolio defense presentations, and AI-assisted voice interview coaching, training students to defend architectural and creative decisions composedly.

faq.question: Is salary negotiation covered?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 11 teaches students how to deconstruct Total Cost to Company (CTC) into net in-hand monthly pay, evaluate employment contracts for red flags, and draft data-backed counter-offer emails.

faq.question: Does the course teach workplace readiness?
faq.answer: Yes. Module 11 includes workplace communication norms (Slack/Teams etiquette), receiving feedback, progress reporting, intellectual property protection, ethical AI boundaries, and crafting a First-90-Days onboarding success plan.

faq.question: Is an actual job offer guaranteed upon course completion?
faq.answer: No. Nova Skills strictly does not offer guaranteed job placements, salary promises, or interview calls. Hiring decisions are made exclusively by prospective employers based on candidate performance and market conditions.

faq.question: Is a real interview invitation required to graduate?
faq.answer: No. Securing an interview invitation from an external company is not a requirement. Graduation is evaluated entirely on demonstrated skill, portfolio quality, and mock interview performance.

faq.question: What are the 14 mandatory portfolio deliverables?
faq.answer: The Career Launch Portfolio includes: (1) LinkedIn Profile, (2) Target Roles Dossier, (3) Skills-Gap Matrix, (4) 3 ATS Resumes, (5) 2 PAR Case Studies, (6) 30-Employer CRM Tracker, (7) 5 Custom Applications, (8) 2 Behavioral Mock Interviews, (9) Technical Assessment Deliverable, (10) Portfolio Defense Video, (11) Offer & Salary Model, (12) Workplace Readiness Plan, (13) Readiness Scorecard, and (14) 60-Day Career Roadmap.

faq.question: What is the course fee?
faq.answer: The active introductory selling fee is INR 14,900. The standard regular fee is INR 19,900. Nova Skills maintains transparent pricing with zero artificial strikethrough discounts.

faq.question: Is GST extra?
faq.answer: Yes. Statutory Goods and Services Tax (18% GST) is applicable and charged extra over the tuition fee as per government regulations.

faq.question: Is an EMI installment payment option available?
faq.answer: Flexible installment and EMI options may be available through approved banking and payment gateway partners subject to credit verification and institutional approval at enrollment.

faq.question: Are paid job-search tools or premium subscriptions included?
faq.answer: No. All coursework is designed to be completed entirely using free tiers of LinkedIn, Google Workspace, GitHub, Figma, and ATS simulators. Paid subscriptions (such as LinkedIn Premium) are completely optional and not required.

faq.question: What placement assistance is provided?
faq.answer: Nova Skills provides structured placement-readiness assistance: resume and portfolio reviews, mock interview feedback, recruiter pipeline tracking, alumni networking, and hiring partner referral access where available. We do not provide guaranteed employment.

faq.question: How does this course differ from Freelancing & Client Acquisition Professional?
faq.answer: Career Launch & Placement Readiness Professional prepares learners for corporate, startup, and agency employment (resumes, ATS, HR interviews, CTC salaries, full-time jobs). In contrast, Freelancing & Client Acquisition Professional focuses on independent solo business operations, freelancing platforms (Upwork, Fiverr), client contracts, and international invoices.

faq.question: What certificate is actually awarded upon graduation?
faq.answer: Graduates earn the institutional Certificate of Completion: Career Launch & Placement Readiness Professional from Nova Skills Institute of Professional Studies, awarded after faculty verification of all 14 portfolio assets and passing the Capstone Oral Viva.

modules.expected_outcome: Graduates emerge fully placement-ready with a verified 14-asset portfolio, clear market positioning, and a structured 60-day roadmap to navigate hiring markets independently.

description: Develop the skills and professional evidence needed to navigate modern recruitment processes. capstone_project.name: Career Launch Portfolio
capstone_project.tagline: One Unified Digital Employment Portfolio with 14 Mandatory Evidence Categories
capstone_project.clarification: The Capstone is ONE comprehensive Career Launch Portfolio containing 14 mandatory evidence categories, NOT 14 separate independent projects. Each asset provides verifiable empirical proof of career readiness.

evidence_categories.objective: Build an All-Star rated professional presence optimized for recruiter keyword search algorithms.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Create custom banner, draft role-tailored headline, author 300+ word About summary, list 50 endorsed skills, and feature proof-of-work links.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: Public live LinkedIn profile URL and verified PDF profile capture.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: All-Star status, custom branded header, keyword-aligned headline, complete education and skills sections, public visibility.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Headline keyword precision (25%), About narrative engagement (25%), Skills tagging accuracy (25%), Visual branding hygiene (25%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Zero false credentials, honest employment dates, accurate educational listings, authentic personal photography.

evidence_categories.category_name: Primary and Secondary Target Roles Dossier
evidence_categories.objective: Establish strategic career clarity by deconstructing primary and secondary target job roles.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Analyze 10 live job postings, document required technical competencies and soft skills, map employer tiers (Tier 1/2/3).
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Clear primary and secondary role profiles with documented core hard skills, soft skills, and salary benchmarks.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Role analysis depth (35%), market requirement alignment (35%), employer tier mapping realism (30%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Grounding role choices in genuine current capabilities and market viability.

evidence_categories.objective: Objectively benchmark current technical capabilities against market requirements and identify remedial priorities.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Evaluate 25 core competencies against active job postings, score proficiency levels (1-5), and outline a 90-day learning roadmap.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative scoring of 25 competencies with concrete 30/60/90-day closure milestones.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Diagnostic self-honesty (40%), competency coverage (30%), actionability of closure plan (30%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Objective self-assessment without unearned proficiency claims.

evidence_categories.objective: Engineer high-impact, single-column, ATS-compatible resumes that parse cleanly across enterprise applicant tracking systems.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Author one comprehensive Master Resume plus two specialized role-tailored resumes using Google X-Y-Z bullet points.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: One Master Resume (PDF) + Two Tailored Resumes (PDF + Word .docx).
evidence_categories.software_platform: Google Docs / Microsoft Word / ATS Simulators
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Single-column layout, standard headers, clean text extraction in ATS scanners, 100% quantified bullet points, zero typos.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: ATS parsing compliance (30%), metric-driven achievement bullets (35%), role customization precision (20%), formatting hygiene (15%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Zero invented achievements, accurate company names, and truthful dates of employment or education.

evidence_categories.objective: Provide undeniable proof of technical problem-solving capability through structured Problem-Action-Result narratives.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Document two technical/creative projects following the PAR methodology, detailing context, constraints, architecture, QA, and results.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: Two published case study links on Behance, GitHub, Figma, Notion, or personal portfolio.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Complete PAR structure, live working demo/source links, documented individual contributions, professional presentation.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Problem articulation & constraints (25%), technical depth of execution (35%), measured outcomes (25%), visual/layout polish (15%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Transparent disclosure of academic/concept status; zero claiming of unauthorized client work; verified personal contribution.

evidence_categories.objective: Implement an active multi-channel CRM to track target employers, applications, and recruiter communication stages.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Research and catalog at least 30 target employers across Tier 1 (Dream), Tier 2 (Growth), and Tier 3 (Stepping Stone) with contacts.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Minimum 30 researched accounts with role titles, company scale, application links, hiring contacts, and status logs.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Tracker architecture & completeness (35%), employer quality & relevance (35%), follow-up cadence discipline (30%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Authentic company research; verified active hiring entities; zero dummy data entries.

evidence_categories.objective: Demonstrate the ability to craft high-yield, customized application packages tailored to specific company briefs.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Prepare five tailored application packets consisting of a customized resume, value-add cover note, and relevant portfolio links.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Five distinct application sets tailored to specific real or simulated company job descriptions, passing pre-flight QA.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Customization relevance (35%), cover note value proposition (35%), submission QA verification (30%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Simulation option fully supported where live submission is unauthorized or inappropriate.

evidence_categories.objective: Master structured behavioral interviewing using the STAR framework (Situation, Task, Action, Result) with emotional composure.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Participate in two evaluated behavioral mock interviews on Google Meet/Zoom, answering core HR and competency questions.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: Two recorded video sessions + completed evaluator scoring rubrics.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Passing score (min. 70%) on STAR structure, answer conciseness (<2 mins), vocal clarity, and reverse questioning.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: STAR framework precision (30%), verbal & non-verbal presence (25%), authenticity & humility (25%), reverse questions (20%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Explicit recorded consent from all participants; genuine personal stories without fabricated metrics.

evidence_categories.objective: Demonstrate practical, production-grade technical execution by completing a realistic hiring challenge in chosen discipline.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Execute the 48-hour hiring challenge brief corresponding to your chosen track (Tracks A through H), cleaning and packaging source files.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: Final technical work sample + organized source repository/archive + technical solution README.
evidence_categories.software_platform: Discipline Tools (VS Code / Figma / Premiere / Make / Python / GitHub)
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Fully functional deliverable meeting all brief specifications, clean source hierarchy, clear technical documentation.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Technical execution correctness (35%), source file organization & hygiene (25%), solution README clarity (20%), QA testing (20%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: 100% independent execution; zero plagiarism; zero uncredited templates; signed Assessment Integrity Pledge.

evidence_categories.category_name: Final Technical Interview or Portfolio Defense
evidence_categories.objective: Defend technical architecture, creative choices, and design trade-offs under cross-examination by senior assessors.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Deliver an individual technical walkthrough of the Module 09 assessment, answering panel questions on edge cases and constraints.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: Recorded Technical Portfolio Defense Video (3-minute walkthrough or panel recording).
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Clear justification of technical decisions, honest acknowledgement of constraints/failures, composed demeanor.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Technical rationale depth (35%), composure under questioning (25%), communication clarity (25%), systems thinking (15%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Truthful representation of personal technical contributions versus external libraries or frameworks.

evidence_categories.objective: Acquire financial literacy regarding Total Cost to Company (CTC) structures and master diplomatic salary negotiation.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Model CTC breakdown vs net monthly take-home pay, audit a sample employment contract, and draft counter-offer email scripts.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: Compensation Modeling Spreadsheet + Written Counter-Offer / Acceptance Drafts.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Accurate calculation of PF, taxes, and in-hand pay; professional, market-backed counter-offer script without ultimatums.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Financial modeling accuracy (35%), contract literacy & risk awareness (35%), negotiation tone & tact (30%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Educational awareness only; understanding that Nova Skills does not provide binding legal or tax advice.

evidence_categories.objective: Establish day-one corporate professionalism, communication norms, and structured 90-day onboarding milestones.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Complete workplace ethics assessment, document communication protocols (SLAs), and author an individualized First-90-Days Plan.
evidence_categories.required_evidence: Workplace Communication Assessment + First-90-Days Professional Onboarding Plan.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Actionable 30/60/90-day onboarding goals, escalation pathways, communication etiquette guidelines.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Workplace protocol comprehension (35%), practical onboarding feasibility (35%), supervisor alignment strategies (30%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Commitment to workplace confidentiality, ethical AI boundaries, and corporate intellectual property protection.

evidence_categories.objective: Obtain an objective, faculty-verified diagnostic evaluation of holistic career readiness across all program domains.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Undergo comprehensive faculty assessment covering research, branding, portfolio quality, interviewing, and workplace readiness.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Minimum passing score of 70% in each evaluative domain across the 100-point holistic model.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Scored across Research (15%), Identity (15%), Portfolio (25%), Interviewing (25%), and Capstone Execution (20%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Objective faculty grading; transparent feedback and remediation milestones where required.

evidence_categories.objective: Transition from structured training to disciplined independent daily job acquisition and continuous professional growth.
evidence_categories.student_tasks: Develop a calendar-mapped 60-day roadmap with weekly application targets, networking goals, and technical revision milestones.
evidence_categories.acceptance_criteria: Quantitative weekly quotas (10-15 applications/wk, 5-10 networking contacts/wk), continuous learning routines.
evidence_categories.assessment_rubric: Roadmap feasibility & rigor (40%), metric-driven accountability (30%), networking strategy integration (30%).
evidence_categories.integrity_checks: Realistic scheduling based on individual availability and target employer recruitment timelines.
